# dsh-plugin-danmu
Real-time danmu for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). It inserts text such as the agent's reasoning, tool call
s and task progress into the conversation area as scrolling text.
Read this in other languages: English | 简体中文
## What is danmu?
Danmu (弹幕) is an interactive mechanism on websites. It first appeared on ニコニコ動画 (hereafter NicoNico)
, where users could display the comments they sent as scrolling subtitles over the page. The mechani
sm later spread widely in China through 哔哩哔哩 (hereafter bilibili), and you can now find it on many v
widely in China through 哔哩哔哩 (hereafter bilibili), and you can now find it on many video platforms.
Notably, the word "弹幕" was originally the Japanese military term "弾幕" (だんまく), commonly translated as
"barrage". It refers to a firing method that does not aim precisely and covers the target with a la
rge number of projectiles.
As the Chinese internet developed, the word "弹幕" in Chinese has generally come to refer to video dan
mu, and the distinct term danmu was born from it. The Chinese "弹幕" (danmu) and the Japanese "弾幕" (da
nmaku) do not have the same meaning, and NicoNico has always called its comments "コメント" (comment).
This project therefore uses danmu as its name, rather than the Japanese romanisation danmaku.
## Installation
You can install it from the dsh plugin manager by entering `dsh-plugin-danmu`. Once installed, the p
lugin appears in the list as Agent Danmu.
DSH manages dependencies through pnpm, and pnpm's `minimumReleaseAge` policy skips versions that hav
e not been published for the configured age (at most 24 hours), so installing a plugin may download
hed for the configured age (at most 24 hours), so installing a plugin may download an older version.
To use the latest plugin version immediately, specify the version when installing, for example `dsh-
plugin-danmu@^0.3.0`. Alternatively, wait for a while until the new version meets the policy, then i
nstall by package name.
## Usage
Once the plugin is installed and enabled, the active danmu region follows the current session and da
nmu are emitted automatically when the agent starts producing output.
Danmu are drawn only inside the conversation content area. They do not cover the session list on the
left, the sidebar on the right or the header. The composer and the status bar also sit inside the a
ctive region, so danmu pass over them briefly, just like the controls inside the bilibili video fram
e. The whole layer is click-through, so selecting text or clicking buttons is unaffected.
The behaviour matches the bilibili web player in speed, font size, row assignment and how it handles
a full content area.
To turn it off, disable the plugin in the plugin manager.

| No danmu appears             | Text only appears while you are talking to the agent. If you see no
ne, it proves the whale is not thinking.

|
| Some danmu are missing       | When the content area runs out of room, the text is dropped, the
same as bilibili

|
| Why are some danmu so long   | bilibili limits each danmu to 100 characters, this project do
es not. Long lines are split at sentence boundaries, but a single long sentence or a table row stays

whole |
| White text in a light theme  | The same style as bilibili, where a black outline keeps it
readable

|
| Does it show emoji           | bilibili has filtered emoji from danmu in recent years.
This project does not and still shows them.

|
| Can I adjust the danmu style | Click the 弹 button at the bottom left of the compose
r to open the settings panel.
ttings panel.                                                                                      |
## Icon
The "弹" glyph in the icon is taken from Lolita, a free typeface for non-commercial use. The typeface
remains under its own licence. The icon is coloured with DeepSeek's theme blue #4D6BFE.
